title: Stairs And Slabs
description: This adds various new stairs and slabs to minecraft.
body: This Mod adds some new stairs and slabs, I will be open for some suggestions, All crafting recipes will work like for slabs the items can be placed bottom, middle and vertical just like how the stairs can be flipped. There are Netherite, Diamond, Gold and iron stairs and slabs but this will update. [Request a Stair/Slab ONE ONLY](https://forms.gle/vfCkX1tsfRoWPJSs6)
